FX-LBLEND-001.says: Hard Light: Overlay with the two swapped, the layer's light half screens and its dark half multiplies; the yellow row lifts red and green and darkens blue.

FX-LBLEND-002.says: Darken: the darker of the two in each channel.

FX-LBLEND-003.says: Lighten: the lighter of the two in each channel.

FX-LBLEND-004.says: Difference: the two apart in each channel; on the grey column the layer's colours turned about 50%.

FX-LBLEND-005.says: Hue: the layer's hue at the backdrop's saturation and lightness; the grey column stays grey.

FX-LBLEND-006.says: Saturation: the backdrop's hue and lightness at the layer's saturation.

FX-LBLEND-007.says: Color: the layer's hue and saturation at the backdrop's lightness.

FX-LBLEND-008.says: Luminosity: the backdrop's hue and saturation at the layer's lightness.

FX-LBLEND-010.says: Color Burn: the backdrop darkened by the layer, (1 - b) / s taken off white; a white layer would leave it as it is.

FX-LBLEND-011.says: Classic Color Burn: Color Burn worked with the layer's colour scaled by its opacity, so the 50% row burns as a darker colour at full weight.

FX-LBLEND-012.says: Linear Burn: b + s - 1, held at 0; darker than Multiply.

FX-LBLEND-013.says: Darker Color: the whole colour of whichever is darker by Lum, never a mix of channels.

FX-LBLEND-014.says: Color Dodge: the backdrop brightened by the layer, b / (1 - s), held at 1; the yellow row's full red turns every red to 1.

FX-LBLEND-015.says: Classic Color Dodge: Color Dodge worked with the layer's colour scaled by its opacity, so the 50% row dodges as a darker colour.

FX-LBLEND-016.says: Lighter Color: the whole colour of whichever is lighter by Lum.

FX-LBLEND-017.says: Linear Light: b + 2 s - 1, held to 0..1.

FX-LBLEND-018.says: Vivid Light: Color Burn by 2 s below a half, Color Dodge by 2 s - 1 above.

FX-LBLEND-019.says: Pin Light: the darker of b and 2 s below a half, the lighter of b and 2 s - 1 above.

FX-LBLEND-020.says: Hard Mix: each channel 0 or 1, 1 where b + s reaches 1.

FX-LBLEND-021.says: Exclusion: b + s - 2 b s, a softer Difference.

FX-LBLEND-023.says: Divide: b / s, held at 1; the yellow row's 0.07 blue turns most blues to 1.

FX-LBLEND-009.says: A mode After Effects has and this program does not, Dissolve (D-920; before D-921 this case was Color Dodge): the file is refused with the reason, which names the thirty modes it knows; nothing is drawn as another mode (document 28).
